props.description: Defines a single inbound or outbound integration endpoint, including the data flows used to process the payload and the response, and incremental-extraction state.

props.label: Inbound
props.description: Direction flag: true when data flows inbound (into Fuuz), false when outbound (Fuuz to external system).

props.label: Auto Retry Responses
props.description: JSON configuration describing which response conditions should trigger an automatic retry.

props.label: Saved Script ID
props.description: Identifier of a saved script associated with this configuration.

props.label: Max Retry Attemps
props.description: Maximum number of times a failed record under this configuration is automatically retried before it stops being reprocessed and is left in a errored state.

props.label: Max Records
props.description: Configure the maximum number of records extracted in one request

props.label: Parameters
props.description: JSON parameters/settings that drive this configuration's behavior.

props.label: Active
props.description: Whether this configuration is currently enabled and eligible to run.
